query: INSERT INTO provider_snapshot_losses (id, lost_snapshots, last_loss_at_unix) VALUES (1, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET lost_snapshots = CASE WHEN lost_snapshots > 9223372036854775807 - excluded.lost_snapshots THEN 9223372036854775807 ELSE lost_snapshots + excluded.lost_snapshots END, last_loss_at_unix = excluded.last_loss_at_unix
